grammar.pattern: 活动 / 性质 + 谓语
grammar.purpose: Use an activity or quality as the subject
grammar.explanation: 学习汉语需要时间 uses a verb phrase as the subject. 认真很重要 uses an adjective as the subject when talking about the quality of being careful. 早起对我来说不容易 uses an activity. Do not add a person to every subject or infer that every adjective can be used this way in every context.

examples.py: xué xí hàn yǔ xū yào shí jiān .
hé duì shí yàn jì lù yǒu bāng zhù .

commonMistakes.wrong: 学习汉语是需要时间人。
commonMistakes.why: The activity itself is the subject; no person noun is required.

grammar.pattern: V + 动作 / 性质 / 主谓短语
grammar.purpose: Identify a phrase as the object
grammar.explanation: 我喜欢学习汉语 has an activity as the object of 喜欢. 我喜欢安静 has a quality as its object. 我希望大家都看懂 has the subject–predicate phrase 大家都看懂 as the object of 希望. The lexical verb determines which complement is natural; do not interchange objects freely.

examples.py: wǒ xǐ huān xué xí hàn yǔ .

examples.zh: 我希望大家都看懂说明。
examples.py: wǒ xī wàng dà jiā dōu kàn dǒng shuō míng .
examples.en: I hope everyone understands the instructions.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我希望说明大家都看懂的。
commonMistakes.right: 我希望大家都看懂说明。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the embedded subject before its predicate and object.

lines.zh: 学科技词语有什么目的？只看过机器还不够。
lines.py: xué kē jì cí yǔ yǒu shén me mù dì ? zhǐ kàn guò jī qì hái bù gòu .
lines.en: What is the purpose of learning technical vocabulary? Seeing the machine alone is insufficient.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我想制作一个练习模型，不说已经发明新设备。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zhì zuò yī gè liàn xí mó xíng , bù shuō yǐ jīng fā míng xīn shè bèi .
lines.en: I want to make a practice model, not claim to have invented new equipment.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 工程师会说明加工和生产，专家也介绍原理。
lines.py: gōng chéng shī huì shuō míng jiā gōng hé shēng chǎn , zhuān jiā yě jiè shào yuán lǐ .
lines.en: The engineer explains processing and production; a specialist introduces the principle.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 学习这些需要时间，认真很重要。
lines.py: xué xí zhè xiē xū yào shí jiān , rèn zhēn hěn zhòng yào .
lines.en: Learning these takes time; care matters.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我希望大家都看懂说明，不只是觉得先进。
lines.py: wǒ xī wàng dà jiā dōu kàn dǒng shuō míng , bù zhǐ shì jué de xiān jìn .
lines.en: I hope everyone understands the instructions, rather than merely thinks the equipment advanced.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 开发工具以前，先做小范围试验。
lines.py: kāi fā gōng jù yǐ qián , xiān zuò xiǎo fàn wéi shì yàn .
lines.en: Before developing the tool, do a small-scale trial.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 实验室时间没确认，工厂也不能直接进去。
lines.py: shí yàn shì shí jiān méi què rèn , gōng chǎng yě bù néng zhí jiē jìn qù .
lines.en: The laboratory time is unconfirmed, and we cannot simply enter the factory.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，实行方案前先核对许可和责任。
lines.py: hǎo , shí xíng fāng àn qián xiān hé duì xǔ kě hé zé rèn .
lines.en: Okay; check permission and responsibility before implementing the plan.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: An activity can be a subject
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 学习技术需要时间，认真很重要；活动或性质本身可以作主语。
lines.py: xué xí jì shù xū yào shí jiān , rèn zhēn hěn zhòng yào ; huó dòng huò xìng zhì běn shēn kě yǐ zuò zhǔ yǔ .
lines.en: Learning technology takes time and care matters; activities or qualities can themselves be subjects.

lines.zh: 我喜欢学习，也喜欢安静；我希望大家都看懂说明，宾语不只可以是物品。
lines.py: wǒ xǐ huān xué xí , yě xǐ huān ān jìng ; wǒ xī wàng dà jiā dōu kàn dǒng shuō míng , bīn yǔ bù zhǐ kě yǐ shì wù pǐn .
lines.en: I like learning and quiet; I hope everyone understands the instructions; objects need not be items.

lines.zh: 科技、工业和发展要放回具体领域，现代化里的化是后缀，不是任意加字。
lines.py: kē jì , gōng yè hé fā zhǎn yào fàng huí jù tǐ lǐng yù , xiàn dài huà lǐ de huà shì hòu zhuì , bù shì rèn yì jiā zì .
lines.en: Science, industry and development need a specific domain; 化 in modernization is a suffix, not arbitrary character addition.

lines.zh: 工程师说明生产和加工，制造机器与制作模型不同，人工检查也可能有错。
lines.py: gōng chéng shī shuō míng shēng chǎn hé jiā gōng , zhì zào jī qì yǔ zhì zuò mó xíng bù tóng , rén gōng jiǎn chá yě kě néng yǒu cuò .
lines.en: The engineer explains production and processing; manufacturing differs from model-making, and human checks may err.

lines.zh: 先进设备仍要实际许可，工厂与实验室都先问进入要求。
lines.py: xiān jìn shè bèi réng yào shí jì xǔ kě , gōng chǎng yǔ shí yàn shì dōu xiān wèn jìn rù yāo qiú .
lines.en: Advanced equipment still needs actual authorization; ask entry requirements for both factory and laboratory.

lines.zh: 实验记录写条件，工具试验写范围，专家解释不替代可核对的依据。
lines.py: shí yàn jì lù xiě tiáo jiàn , gōng jù shì yàn xiě fàn wéi , zhuān jiā jiě shì bù tì dài kě hé duì de yī jù .
lines.en: Experiment records state conditions and tool trials their scope; expert explanations do not replace checkable evidence.

lines.zh: 开发可能产生新问题，不能把一次结果直接写成发明。
lines.py: kāi fā kě néng chǎn shēng xīn wèn tí , bù néng bǎ yī cì jié guǒ zhí jiē xiě chéng fā míng .
lines.en: Development may raise new questions; one result should not directly be described as an invention.

lines.zh: 建立目标，再看实际转变；方案确认以后实行，不以设备名字冒充学习完成。
lines.py: jiàn lì mù biāo , zài kàn shí jì zhuǎn biàn ; fāng àn què rèn yǐ hòu shí xíng , bù yǐ shè bèi míng zi mào chōng xué xí wán chéng .
lines.en: Establish a goal and inspect actual change; implement confirmed plans rather than call equipment ownership completed learning.
